snippet: Gastric cancer-related long non-coding RNA1 () is an emerging oncogenic regulator in multiple malignancies, including gastric, colorectal, ovarian, and bladder cancers, as well as osteosarcoma. It promotes proliferation, inhibits apoptosis, and enhances drug resistance and metastasis. Mechanistically,dysregulates key cancer-related regulators and pathways,....
